description: Submit an update request to an existing member where the attribute map carries several keys supplied out of alphabetical order, covering both a successful persistence and a validation failure carrying multiple error entries. On success the response redirects to the member's canonical URL with a success flash notice naming the resource. On failure the controller re-renders the edit-member view with a success status and no flash. The transcript renders the submitted fields as a key-sorted, comma-separated list.

cases.expected_output:
store=find id=5
store=update attrs={alpha=1,beta=2,gamma=3} ok=true
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles/5
flash.notice=Article was successfully updated.

store=find id=5
store=update attrs={alpha=1,beta=2,gamma=3} ok=false
assign=article
status=200
body=Edit HTML
